purpose: Measure how the submitted v11 LightGBM pipeline degrades when validation inputs lose call_sign or tonnage or carry name noise. The new Public score (0.88) is far below the clean local five-fold group OOF (weighted about 0.9968), so this protocol looks for input conditions the clean OOF does not cover.
non_goals: Not an estimate of the leaderboard or Private score. Perturbations are hypotheses about the new evaluation rows, not observations of them.
Not a model-selection set. No model, feature, or threshold is chosen from these results inside this protocol.
No retraining. Only validation inputs are changed.

observed_train_profile.note: Training rows are clean: every row has a call sign, Korean rows always have tonnage, and a vessel almost never appears under two names. v11 uses call_sign only as a train-table override, not as a ranker feature.

frozen_inputs.baseline_config: retrain_config.baseline_config() (lightgbm_v11, override_policy=callsign_and_name, all other knobs at baseline)

execution_rules.models: Load each fold's frozen baseline booster text (verify sha256 first). Do not retrain.
execution_rules.resources: Rebuild lookup tables from that fold's training rows only, under retrain_runtime.v11_globals(baseline_config()).
execution_rules.perturbation_scope: Change validation input columns only, after dropping target_vessel_id. Training rows, catalog, model, and lookup tables stay unchanged.
execution_rules.row_independence: Each perturbed value is a pure function of (protocol_version, scenario_id, sample_id, that row's own input columns). The only extra input allowed is the fold's training call-sign table for C2. Never read validation labels or other validation rows.
execution_rules.determinism: u(sample_id, scenario_id, salt) = int(sha256(f'v11-stress-oof-1|{scenario_id}|{salt}|{sample_id}').hexdigest()[:16], 16) / 2**64. Row selection uses u < rate; operation and position choices use further salts. No global RNG.
execution_rules.labels: Join validation labels only in the evaluation step, after all predictions for a scenario are final, as in v11_improvement_worker._evaluate.
execution_rules.overrides: Use the submitted v11 override policy callsign_and_name in every scenario.
execution_rules.missing_value_encoding: Write a removed value as NaN (pandas missing), the same way the official CSV reads empty cells.

gates.G0_clean_replay: Before any stress scenario, rerun S0 for all five folds. Per fold, candidates_sha256 and features_sha256 must equal frozen_inputs, and final_pred_id must equal the stored clean case file for every row (12,222/12,222). If anything differs, stop, run no stress scenario, and record the mismatch.
gates.G1_perturbation_audit: For every scenario and fold, record eligible rows, rows actually changed, and per-column change counts. A scenario that changes 0 eligible rows is reported as not_applicable, not as robust.
gates.G2_row_independence: Per scenario and fold, the existing sample check (reversed subset and single-row prediction, at least 5 rows including Korean and non-Korean) must pass on the perturbed inputs.
gates.G3_sanity_expectation: C1 is expected to change no prediction, because overrides never fired in the clean group OOF. If C1 changes predictions, investigate before interpreting the other call-sign results.

scenarios.op: Replace call_sign with a call sign from the fold's training call-sign table, picked as sorted(train_callsigns)[floor(u(salt='pick') * n)]. The validation target is never in the training table (group-disjoint), so a fired override is always wrong. This measures the risk that a reused or colliding call sign sends the override to a different vessel.
gross_tonnage = NaN and international_gross_tonnage = NaN. Report Korean rows separately: Korean training rows never lack tonnage.

scenarios.rows: rows with at least one positive tonnage
scenarios.op: Multiply both present tonnage values by 1.2 if u(salt='sign') < 0.5, else by 0.8.

scenarios.rows: rows where both tonnage values are present and differ

scenarios.op: Non-Korean: remove every whitespace. Korean: insert one space after syllable index floor(len/2) when len >= 2.

scenarios.rows: names with at least 4 non-space characters
scenarios.op: Exactly one edit at a deterministic position. Non-Korean: choose by u(salt='op') among delete one letter / substitute one letter with the next letter in A-Z (Z->A) / transpose two adjacent letters; never touch digits. Korean: delete one Hangul syllable if there are at least 4 syllables, else transpose two adjacent syllables.
Non-Korean: prepend 'M/V ' unless the name already starts with M/V or MV. Korean: append '호' unless the name ends with '호', else remove that final '호'.

scenarios.rows: non-Korean names with a standalone integer token
scenarios.op: Rewrite the last standalone integer token N as 'NO.N'. Rows without such a token are not eligible.

scenarios.rows: non-Korean names with at least 2 whitespace tokens
scenarios.op: Move the first token to the end.

Apply each component independently with its own salt: C1 at 0.30, T1 at 0.20, F1 at 0.20, and one of N1/N2/N3 (chosen by u(salt='name_op')) at 0.30. No C2 collision. Record the applied combination per row in local_only.

metrics_per_scenario: all / korean / non_korean accuracy with correct/rows counts
official weighted score from src.metric.calculate_score, and raw 0.7*korean + 0.3*non_korean
delta of each metric against S0 (same rows)
paired rows vs S0: newly wrong, newly correct, changed predictions, split by language
candidate recall (truth_in_candidates) and mean candidate count
error primary types (error_diagnostics) for the newly wrong rows
truth rank distribution for newly wrong rows: missing / 2-5 / 6+
override counts by source and errors where the override changed the answer
eligible rows, changed rows, validation prediction seconds

outputs.pre_run_intent: protocol file path and sha256, source hashes, input hashes, frozen model hashes verified, zip snapshot
outputs.local_only: per-row perturbed inputs and predictions with sample ids; never sent to an LLM or committed
outputs.completion_verification: all gates, source hashes unchanged during the run, zip hashes unchanged, leaderboard_submission false

interpretation.primary_readout: Sensitivity = weighted-score drop vs S0, reported per scenario with Korean and non-Korean counts. Rank scenarios by sensitivity.
interpretation.use_of_results: The ranking only proposes the next hypotheses (for example tonnage-missing robustness, name-noise augmentation in training, or a stricter override rule). Any fix gets its own protocol frozen before evaluation, with a clean-OOF non-regression gate plus a stress-gain gate.
limits: All official target groups were exposed in earlier validation and error analysis; results are exploratory.
Perturbation types and strengths are assumptions. A large drop shows a vulnerability, not that the test set contains that perturbation.
Scenario thresholds and parameters must not be changed after seeing any stress result; a change needs a new protocol version.

budget.expected_cost: No training. About 213 s of validation prediction per clean pass over five folds in the source run, so about 14 scenarios x 5 folds is roughly 1 hour on the same PC plus resource rebuilds.
